record.title: Evaluate preserved baseline and admit physical installation successors
record.intent: Continue autonomously into ordinary options and then separate D capability only where evidence supports the exact procedure.
requirements: Evaluate stored-image completeness, rollback evidence and installation readiness; admit bounded installation and reboot-verification tasks when supported.

Preserve failures and branch deliberately without repeating experiments to obtain a desired result. Latest operator authorization includes physical installs and required reboots through capability verification, but excludes unplanned calibration or RF claims.
acceptance: A concrete continuation or evidence-backed blocker is recorded.
